Umar Bello 109 | +91 98765 43210 | umar.bello@cybershield.tech | Bangalore, India  

Completed a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Technology in 2021. The program emphasized foundational programming, data structures, and algorithmic problem-solving, which formed the basis for subsequent career development. Graduated with a focus on software architecture and systems design, enabling seamless transitions into DevOps and cloud engineering roles.  

At TechStart Solutions (2021), I transitioned from a junior developer to a DevOps Engineer, supporting the deployment of scalable infrastructure for SaaS applications. Key contributions included automating CI/CD pipelines for 15+ microservices, reducing deployment time by 40% and deployment errors by 65%. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate cloud-native tools, ensuring compliance with industry standards. This role solidified expertise in AWS and infrastructure automation.  

In 2022, I joined SecureNet Systems as a Cloud Security Engineer, where I designed and implemented security frameworks for hybrid cloud environments. Focused on securing API gateways and managing access controls, which led to a 30% improvement in incident response times. Played a central role in migrating legacy systems to AWS, optimizing costs by 22% through resource allocation strategies. This experience deepened understanding of cloud networking and security best practices.  

Currently, as a Platform Engineer at CyberShield Technologies (2023), I lead the design and maintenance of scalable cloud platforms for cybersecurity tools. Responsibilities include managing Kubernetes clusters, configuring load balancers for high-availability services, and implementing Terraform for infrastructure as code. Recent projects involved rearchitecting a distributed logging system, which increased data processing efficiency by 50% and reduced operational overhead.  

Outside of work, I contributed to open-source projects focused on cloud security tools. Developed a Terraform module for automating VPC setups, adopted by three teams within the organization. Also, mentored junior engineers on Kubernetes best practices, resulting in a 25% reduction in deployment-related incidents. These projects reinforced the importance of modular, maintainable infrastructure.  

Technical expertise includes Python for scripting automation tasks, REST API design for integrating security tools, Docker for containerization, and load balancing for distributing traffic across microservices. AWS is central to my workflow, with ownership of multiple production environments. Cloud networking, particularly VPC design, is a core focus, with measurable impact on network latency and security. Infrastructure as Code, primarily through Terraform, drives consistency across deployments. Kubernetes management is a daily responsibility, ensuring reliable scaling for high-traffic applications.  

Certifications include AWS Certified Solutions Architect and DevOps Engineer, reflecting hands-on experience with cloud platforms and automation.  

Recognized for optimizing cloud costs and improving system reliability, with specific praise for Terraform-driven infrastructure and Kubernetes cluster management. Awards include a company-wide innovation prize for a tool that streamlined security audits.
